title: Savannah Guthrie 'in full panic mode' as Today ratings soar during her hiatus - NewsBreak
text:
By Melody Rivera ,
58 minutes ago Savannah Guthrie is in “full panic mode” during her leave from the Today show.
The 54-year-old anchor is in the middle of recovering from having her vocal cord nodules removed. The operation has pulled her off her usual spot on the morning show , leaving Sheinelle Jones filling in for her beside Craig Melvin for a couple weeks.
Savannah is hoping to return Monday, January 26. Until then, she is reportedly “shaken” after new figures revealed Today’s rating surged since her absence. During the last week of December, the show garnered 12% more viewers compared to that same week the year prior.

A source revealed to the Daily Mail, “Savannah is in full panic mode.
“Savannah is trying to laugh it off publicly, but privately, she's completely shaken,” the source claimed. “Seeing the ratings tick up without her hit a nerve she didn't know she had.
The anchor is taking the bump “personal” as she thought viewers would miss her instantly. Now, she is questioning if they have “quietly moved on.
“Blindsided” Savannah is reportedly rethinking her belief that “she was the glue holding the show together.”
“She keeps asking, ‘Is this a fluke?’ But no one's giving her a straight answer, which is making it worse.
The lack of clarification from her peers has her “refreshing the ratings reports like it's her full-time job.”
“It's consuming her,” the source said. “She's hyper-aware now of every on-air decision, every co-host moment . It's like she's watching the show from the outside for the first time.”
With her mind uneasy, the anchor has found it hard to focus on her recovery. She is “pushing her doctors to get her back to work as soon as possible.”
She has also allegedly insisted the show broadcast her recovering from home, in hopes fans won’t forget about her.
On Tuesday, January 20, she appeared on the live show via video call. While speaking to her co-anchors, she said, “This is my new voice.”
She revealed details about the surgery and the recovery process , which she says is “slowly” coming along.
“You're allowed to talk, and then if you talk too much - which is a real risk for me,” she mentioned.
Savannah first announced she would be stepping away from the show on December 19.
While on air, she told viewers, “Some of you have noticed that my voice had been very scratchy and started to crack a bit. Well, I have found out what it is. I have nodules and also a polyp.
“It's not a big, big deal, but I am going to have to have surgery in the new year and be off for a couple of weeks, so this is my last day for a while,” she mentioned.
